other_conditions: Must be a resident of Telangana
Pregnant woman must be in her first or second trimester of pregnancy
Delivery must take place at a designated healthcare facility or with a qualified healthcare provider
Family with a newborn is also eligible
benefits_summary: Provides one full daily meal plus iron and folic acid tablets to pregnant and lactating women, and supplementary nutrition (eggs and Balamrutham) to children under six years of age.
